load_policy: strict _require when section present; absent section = shadow disabled

dynamic_loading.semantics: reload interpretation config between runs only unless explicit hot-reload plan; no silent mid-bar mutation

per_dimension.label_bands: optional ordered thresholds for categorical labels ONLY (HOW)

validation_rules: enabled true requires non-empty dimensions with at least one enabled
source_features must exist in FeaturePipeline / CANONICAL or registered non-vector WHAT
no field may authorize CRT mutation
no field may set trade thresholds for CRTConfig
instrument_overrides and timeframe_overrides may only modify label_bands / enables — never source feature identities or encodings
optional HOW labels require continuous twin values emitted alongside
crt_phase_observation_enabled cannot make crt_state a required identity field of other dimensions
CRT-local atr/ema/body/wick must not be listed as source_features until parity audit PASS/TRANSFORM registered

ownership.WHO: shadow emitter / research consumers — not CRTEngine until BEHAVIOR_CHANGE_AUTHORIZED migration
